Chapter Details: The architecture, governance, functionality and uptake of government data exchange systems. 25 variables in 4 sections. Contains latest available data. Data collection by Perplexity from a variety of sources.
Definition: Level of public transparency regarding data exchange operations, governance, and data sharing agreements
Comments: Kenya has a strong open data tradition. Data Protection Act 2019 established Office of Data Protection Commissioner (ODPC) with enforcement powers including fines for non-compliance. Kenya Open Data Initiative operational. eCitizen publishes privacy policy and data handling terms. Annual reports published. ODPC investigates complaints publicly. No real-time public dashboard for data exchange operations but moderate/annual reporting exists.

revision_notes: Original cited sources were weak: the LinkedIn article sits behind a login wall and could not be verified, and the Digital Policy Alert page only confirms the 2019 entry into force of the Data Protection Act without addressing transparency of data exchange operations specifically. Re-verified via the Office of the Data Protection Commissioner (ODPC), which publishes annual reports, a searchable public register of registered data handlers, and a Data Sharing Code (March 2025) setting out procedural rules for data sharing agreements. The National Government Dashboard System (unveiled June 2026) adds a public project-monitoring dashboard, though it covers general government projects rather than the data exchange specifically; no dedicated public dashboard reporting on the operations of Kenya's data exchange/interoperability layer itself was found. Score of 3 (Moderate — Annual Reports) is confirmed on this stronger evidence base; not upgraded to 4 for lack of a dedicated public dashboard.
revised_comments: Kenya publishes moderate, annual-report-level transparency on data governance and sharing rather than a live public dashboard specific to the data exchange itself. The Office of the Data Protection Commissioner (ODPC) issues annual reports, maintains a public register of registered data controllers and processors, and has published a Data Sharing Code (2025) setting out procedural rules for data sharing agreements. The Kenya Open Data Initiative and eCitizen privacy disclosures provide further routine public reporting. A broader National Government Dashboard System, unveiled in June 2026, tracks progress on government projects generally, though it is not specific to data exchange operations. No dedicated public dashboard covering the operations, governance or data-sharing agreements of the data exchange itself is currently available.
